refinements.prompt: Edit only the specific errors in this existing transparent HITCH RING TOSS retro painted sport logo. Correction1: the complete exact title must clearly read HITCH RING TOSS. Make the T immediately before the brass-ring O fully visible, so the lower title clearly spells R I N G [space] T O S S, not RING OSS. It must not be a farm tractor. Preserve the trailer passing physically through the ring. No extra text, no new backdrop. Genuine transparent alpha and a complete uncropped silhouette.
